THE PRODUCT

AI reviews grain photos and intake documents before a lot is released.

For grain aggregators and warehouse quality teams. GrainLedger checks standardized grain photos, reads weight and moisture records, and flags lots that need a human quality check.

THE PRODUCT, IN USE

A quality check for
every incoming grain lot.

Choose a case, run the prepared analysis and open the evidence behind each finding. The decision stays with the person responsible for the work.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

Visual grading is a screening step. A warehouse specialist confirms the grade, sampling method and test results.

  1. 01

    Receive the sample

    Add standard intake photos, scale tickets and the moisture reading.

  2. 02

    Check the grain

    Look for broken or discolored grains and foreign material.

  3. 03

    Compare the records

    Match the lot reference, weights and quality observations.

  4. 04

    Release or hold

    A quality manager reviews the evidence and records the decision.
